description:
Build unsigned Kaspa transactions ready for signing. Returns the unsigned transaction and fee details. After preparing, sign locally (kaspa_sign) and broadcast via broadcast_signed_transaction.

Actions:
• native-coins: Build an unsigned native KAS transfer, supporting multiple recipients in one transaction

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• native-coins: 60

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

exactFee.description: Exact fee override in KAS - bypasses mass-based fee calculation when set

feePriority.description: Fee priority tier - defaults to standard if omitted

recipients.description: Recipients as {address, amount} objects, amount in KAS main units - one output per entry, multiple recipients supported in a single transaction (required)

name: prepare_transactions__prepare_transactions_kaspa
